scripts.audit:release: pnpm audit:history && pnpm audit:licenses && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=low
scripts.agent:check: noodle validate --json && noodle test --json && noodle tools list --json && noodle check --json
scripts.agent:check:live: noodle validate src/live-server.ts --json && noodle check src/live-server.ts --json
scripts.agent:check:chatgpt: noodle validate --json && noodle test --json && noodle check --target chatgpt --json
scripts.agent:check:assistant: noodle validate src/embedded-server.ts --json && noodle check src/embedded-server.ts --target embedded-assistant --json
scripts.check:embedded-host: pnpm --filter @nuitee-travel-starter/embedded-assistant-host typecheck && pnpm --filter @nuitee-travel-starter/embedded-assistant-host test && pnpm --filter @nuitee-travel-starter/embedded-assistant-host build
scripts.ci:offline: pnpm agent:doctor && pnpm customize:check && pnpm audit:history && pnpm audit:licenses && pnpm test && pnpm agent:check && pnpm agent:check:live && pnpm agent:check:assistant && pnpm check:embedded-host
